description: This Java class implements the UserDetailsService interface from Spring Security to load user details for authentication purposes, retrieving user data via a UserRepository and mapping it to UserDetails objects.

classes.name: DatabaseUserDetailsService
classes.description: A service class that loads user details from the database for authentication.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details based on the provided username (email), throws UsernameNotFoundException if user not found.
